lane_declaration: Self-declared orthogonal research lane. Prompt references 'the single method paragraph below' without supplying a standalone method paragraph (IR-78-01, IR-79-01). This lane builds on the forensic finding that 100% of organizer-scored truth that is recoverable sits >200m from the catalogue, but >3px off the H19-5 support has not yet earned live credit with any measured field (H78 E1/E2 negative). The lane targets a distinct physical signature: coincident basement potential-field step + surficial curvature ridge, which discriminates active normal-fault steps from shoreline terraces (no geophysical step) and lithologic contacts (no curvature).

ranked_hypotheses.title: Coincident Basement Potential-Field Step + Topographic Curvature Ridge (Cross-Gradient Confluence x Ridge)
layers: training_features.tif bands 2 (rtp), 3 (tmi_hg), 9 (tmi_vg), 11 (iso_grav_anom_vg), 13 (iso_grav_anom), 14 (tmi), 12 (det_elev), 19 (det_elev_slope) — 100% official competition cache, SHA-pinned

Derived mag_tilt = atan2(tmi_vg, max(tmi_hg,eps)), mag_as = sqrt(tmi_hg^2+tmi_vg^2), grav_thdr = hypot(grad(iso_grav_anom)), grav_tilt = atan2(iso_grav_anom_vg, grav_thdr), grav_as = sqrt(grav_thdr^2+iso_grav_anom_vg^2), all filled median in footprint, nearest for FFT
Contact-confluence scalar: min(rank(mag_as), rank(grav_as)) * sqrt(wz_mag*wz_grav) where wz = 1-|tilt|/(pi/2) (zero-contour proximity)
Topographic ridge: hessian_ridge(det_elev, sigma=1.0,2.0,3.5) + gaussian curvature + structure_tensor coherence (sigma 2.0) — 100% footprint, no LiDAR dependency
Final score = confluence * (ridge1+ridge2)/2 * coherence — cross-sensor edge coincidence plus surficial expression
Visible catalogue geometry only via fold['visible'] distance masking for holdout (no catalogue-derived features in scoring)
ranked_hypotheses.physical_signature: A normal-fault step offsets basement density & magnetization (coincident grav/mag tilt zero, peak analytic signal) while the updip continuation produces a linear topographic curvature ridge (crest-trough dipole) with high along-strike coherence. Their product is high only where a basement step has surficial expression; one-sided step polarity (hanging-wall drop) further distinguishes from symmetric washes.
ranked_hypotheses.why_unmapped_not_catalogued: Buried intrabasin faults under 100-1500m Quaternary fill have zero aerial-photo scarp but a persistent basement step (Faulds & Henry 2008; Blakely & Simpson 1986). Shorelines have curvature without basement step; SGMC lithologic contacts have potential-field step without Quaternary curvature — product vetoes both.
ranked_hypotheses.named_non_fault_mimic: Pleistocene Lake Lahontan (1332m) and Bonneville (1552m) wave-cut terrace risers (symmetric curvature, no basement throw, no mag tilt zero); symmetric V-shaped desert washes (curvature but grav/mag confluence ~0); unreactivated Mesozoic thrusts (grav step but no Quaternary scarp curvature)
ranked_hypotheses.difference_vs_repo: H77D used hydro+LOCO+scarp+submod with 92 channels; H77-Step used HW/FW step tensor + V-LBCO + Radon multi-azimuth; H78 used 7-operator lidar consensus only to rank off-support dots; LIA used straight edges; Contactphys used front-base asymmetry; Selective-U used U rank curvature. None used mag-grav cross-gradient confluence weighted by topographic ridge as primary scorer. This lane uses 0 SGMC, 0 lidar-external, 0 GDR thermal, 0 H19-5 pixel reuse — pure competition-band potential-field + DEM derivatives.
ranked_hypotheses.expected_dti_gain_qualitative: MEDIUM-HIGH (+0.015-0.03 HOLDOUT-DTI hoped) where blind faults have subtle scarps; zero where fully buried (needs independent geophysical-only corroboration).
ranked_hypotheses.implementation_cost: Low (CPU raster ops, ~3 min, no training, no external data beyond pinned cache)

ranked_hypotheses.title: Drainage Network Deflection + Profile Curvature Break
layers: det_elev, det_elev_slope (bands 12,19) + flow accumulation & channel deflection azimuth from DEM (D8)
ranked_hypotheses.physical_signature: Fault-perpendicular drainage deflection (orthogonal channel bearing change) coincident with linear profile-curvature break and openness minimum.
ranked_hypotheses.why_unmapped_not_catalogued: Blind/buried faults warp the piedmont fan surface and offset ephemeral channels laterally/vertically below the 1:24k mapping threshold; channels are sensitive strain markers (Bull 2007).
ranked_hypotheses.named_non_fault_mimic: Lithology-controlled channel capture, irrigation ditches, and Lake Lahontan spillway channels (curvature without fault-aligned deflection cluster).
ranked_hypotheses.difference_vs_repo: Prior DEM lanes used curvature/ridge amplitude only, not channel-network deflection azimuth; this adds an independent fluvial-strain sensor.

ranked_hypotheses.title: Multi-Scale Analytic-Signal Edge Coincidence (Magnetic × Gravimetric × Radiometric K/Th)
layers: tmi_hg, tmi_vg, iso_grav_anom, iso_grav_anom_vg, tc (band6, radiometric total count) + K/Th from external GeoDAWN (optional, not required)
ranked_hypotheses.physical_signature: Co-located peaks of mag analytic signal and grav THDR across scales (1-6 px) plus coincident K/Th radiometric boundary — basement fault juxtaposing lithologies.
ranked_hypotheses.why_unmapped_not_catalogued: Concealed basin-bounding faults offset lithologic packages without Quaternary scarp; multi-sensor coincidence discriminates regional lithologic trends.
ranked_hypotheses.named_non_fault_mimic: Pure lithologic contacts (radiometric boundary without active scarp) and flight-line artifacts (single-sensor linear).
ranked_hypotheses.difference_vs_repo: H77 variants used radiometric quantiles separately; none used multi-scale analytic-signal coincidence as primary.
ranked_hypotheses.expected_dti_gain_qualitative: Medium; higher false-positive risk without curvature veto

ranked_hypotheses.title: Thermal Anomaly Gradient Aligned to Structure (GDR 2m Probes)
layers: GDR 1391 2m probe anomalies + well/spring geothermometers + TMI_up150/RTP magnetite destruction proxy
ranked_hypotheses.physical_signature: Linear thermal gradient ridge aligned with a potential-field step and curvature break, indicating permeable fault-controlled upflow.
ranked_hypotheses.why_unmapped_not_catalogued: Hydrothermal alteration demagnetizes and argillizes the fault zone, reducing scarp preservation but preserving thermal memory in shallow probes.
ranked_hypotheses.named_non_fault_mimic: Closed-basin evaporative brines (diffuse thermal halo without structural alignment) and unaltered ash-flow tuffs.
ranked_hypotheses.difference_vs_repo: H77D already used thermal manifestations heavily (ablation + live inversion); this would duplicate that lane.
ranked_hypotheses.expected_dti_gain_qualitative: Moderate in geothermal districts; sparse coverage elsewhere

ranked_hypotheses.title: Piedmont Sinuosity + Openness + Local Relief Multi-Scale Topo Ensemble
layers: det_elev, dem curvature, relief5, tophat5, openness, LRM — all derivable from DEM
ranked_hypotheses.physical_signature: Low-sinuosity linear ridge with high openness contrast and local relief, characteristic of youthful fault-line scarps.
ranked_hypotheses.why_unmapped_not_catalogued: Sub-meter scarps below Qfault mapping scale but visible in openness/relief texture.
ranked_hypotheses.named_non_fault_mimic: Fan-head trenches, terracettes, and cattle trails (linear openness without coherence).
ranked_hypotheses.difference_vs_repo: Similar to H78 lidar consensus but topo-only (no 1m LiDAR), so would be a sensitivity control rather than novel.
ranked_hypotheses.expected_dti_gain_qualitative: Low-Medium; already covered by Step/H77D ablations

promotion_rule: format valid: 17/17 portal-equivalence checks PASS (single-band float32, EPSG:32611, 3730x3292, transform (100,0,243350,0,-100,4508550), values in [0,1], no NaN inside footprint, zeros outside, 0 dots on catalogue)

unique informative reading: rho <=0.90 and max forward 3px overlap <=0.70 vs every informative registry raster on surface AND final dots; dense space-filling witnesses reported separately as policy I17 literal gate (not informative)
canary: every feature alone AUC <=0.90 on holdout (else flag leakage)

paired HOLDOUT-DTI delta vs champion construction: report with 95% CI; promotion requires CI not entirely below 0 AND beating prior holdout best would be noted but not required for deliverable — negative is deliverable
literal dense witness (I17) is a separate policy gate reported as FAIL-closed; informative PASS is the scientific uniqueness metric
